name: SuiteText
description: The live text service on Core Text: LiveText, SuiteModel's TextServices made real (measure spans, list the Mac's font families, draw placed glyphs). Its own module so a headless tool can draw text without SuiteShell's UI glue; SuiteShell re-exports it for the apps. Imports SuiteModel only.
technology: Swift 6, Core Text and AppKit, macOS 26
